name: Drilling slots / well bays
description: Malaysian Tarpon minimum-facility WHPs for PETRONAS Carigali were built with three 20-inch conductor slots internal to the caisson (two used, one spare) in 70-85 m water, while the West Desaru conductor-supported WSS grew from 18 wellhead flowline connections at the outset to 28 in the final design.
